title: 육군보병학교령 / queue:ADDENDUM:13708:19920813:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act <Presidential Decree No. 13708, August 13, 1992>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (6) Omitted.
(7) Part of the Decree on the Army Infantry School shall be amended as follows:
Article 2 (2) shall be replaced with the following:
(2) The Commandant shall be appointed from among general-grade officers of the Army.
(8) and (9) Omitted.
